query HeroCustomers($first: Int!, $offset: Int!, $orderBy: String!, $showDeleted: Boolean!) {
  contacts(
    first: $first
    offset: $offset
    orderBy: $orderBy
    show_deleted: $showDeleted
  ) {
    id
    nr
    title
    first_name
    last_name
    full_name
    email
    phone_mobile
    phone_home
    company_name
    category
    type
    source
    is_contact_person
    is_deleted
    address {
      id
      street
      line_2
      zipcode
      city
      country {
        code
      }
      full_address
      latitude
      line_1
      longitude
      state_id
    }
    accounting {
      bank_name
      bic
      created
      debitor_number
      iban
      id
      modified
      ust_id_number
    }
    birth_date
    company_legal_form
    contact_match_id
    contacts {
      email
      first_name
      id
      is_contact_person
      is_deleted
      last_name
      parent_customer_id
      phone_home
      phone_mobile
      position
      title
    }
    created
    customer_addresses {
      address {
        city
        country {
          code
        }
        id
        line_2
        street
        zipcode
      }
      is_deleted
    }
    is_invoice_recipient
    leitweg_nr
    modified
    parent_customer_id
    partner_notes
    phone_fax
    position
    reachability
    title_custom
    url
    address_id
    category_name
    company_id
    contact_match {
      id
      name
    }
    initial_name
    parent_customer {
      id
    }
    phone_home_formatted
    phone_mobile_formatted
    reachability_string
    supply_operator {
      id
      name
    }
    user {
      id
    }
    user_id
  }
}

query HeroProjectMatches($first: Int!, $offset: Int!, $orderBy: String!, $history_offset: Int!) {
  project_matches(first: $first, offset: $offset, orderBy: $orderBy) {
    id
    customer_id
    project_id
    project_title
    project_nr
    project_type
    partner_notes
    customer {
      title
      full_name
      id
    }
    address {
      full_address
      city
      country {
        code
        name
      }
      id
      line_2
      street
      zipcode
      latitude
      line_1
      longitude
      state_id
    }
    display_id
    created
    modified
    measure {
      short
      name
      id
    }
    volume
    name
    partner_source
    partner_id
    project_match_assignments {
      user_id
      created
      id
      modified
      project_match_id
      reason
    }
    current_project_match_status {
      id
      status_code
      name
      short_name
      created
      modified
      step_id
      maturity_date
      maturity_time
      previous_project_match_status_id
      show_as_skipped
    }
    company_branch_id
    contact_id
    is_deleted
    marked_company
    marked_later
    ppl_price
    project_match_statuses {
      created
      id
      maturity_date
      maturity_time
      modified
      name
      previous_project_match_status_id
      short_name
      show_as_skipped
      status_code
      step_id
    }
    relative_id
    type {
      name
      id
    }
    type_id
    histories(first: 100, offset: $history_offset, orderBy: "id") {
      id
      created
      modified
      custom_title
      custom_text
      author_name
      role_visibility
      user_id
      user {
        id
        email
      }
      target_project_match_id
      target_project_match {
        id
      }
      target_company_id
      target_company {
        id
      }
      target
      target_id
      target_job {
        id
      }
      type_code
      type
      is_editable
      associated_outbox_mail_id
      associated_outbox_mail {
        id
      }
      target_user_id
      target_user {
        id
      }
      target_project_id
      target_project {
        id
      }
      additional_file_uploads {
        id
      }
      weather_attachment {
        main
        description
        temp
        wind
        emoji
        icon
      }
    }
    address_id
    company_branch {
      id
      name
    }
    company_id
    contact {
      full_name
      id
    }
    current_project_match_status_id
    measure_id
    partner {
      full_name
      id
      name
    }
    project {
      id
      name
    }
  }
}

query HeroCalendarEvents($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) {
  calendar_events(first: $first, offset: $offset, orderBy: "id") {
    category_id
    project_match_id
    title
    description
    start
    end
    all_day
    deleted
    color
    is_done
    is_recurring
    provider
    id
    modified
    created
    type
    localized_type
    full_address
    readonly
    resources {
      id
      name
      type
      type_id
    }
    partners {
      id
      full_name
    }
    category {
      name
      color
      created
      deleted
      id
      modified
    }
    project_match {
      id
      name
    }
    title_lines
  }
}

query DirectHeroProducts($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) {
  supply_product_versions(first: $first, offset: $offset, orderBy: "product_id") {
    base_data {
      category
      delivery_time
      description
      ean
      manufacturer
      manufacturer_nr
      name
      quantity_min
      supplier_id
      supply_catalog {
        name
      }
      unit_type
      created
      external_url
      file_upload_id
      image_src
      manufacturer_type_name
      matchcode
      modified
      price_quantity
      quantity_interval
      supply_catalog_id
      company_id
      id
      is_deleted
      is_from_product_nexus
      product_id
    }
    base_price
    is_deleted
    list_price
    nr
    product_id
    sales_prices {
      net_price_per_unit
      supply_sales_price {
        is_default
      }
      id
      supply_sales_price_id
      label
      hasDifferentPrice
      modified
      created
    }
    supply_operator {
      name
      id
    }
    attributes
    created
    default_sales_price_id
    delivery_time
    id
    internal_identifier
    modified
    price_quantity
    quantity_interval
    quantity_min
    stock_materials {
      category
      created
      description
      has_stock_material_sources
      id
      item_number
      min_stock
      modified
      name
      open_consignment_items_amount
      open_order_items_amount
      qr_id
      qr_payload
      target_stock
      total_stock
      unit_type
      stock_material_sources {
        id
        product_id
        stock_material_id
        company_id
        created
        modified
      }
    }
    supply_operator_id
    supply_surcharges {
      calculated_value
      created
      description
      id
      is_material_dependent
      is_percentual
      modified
      product_id
      value
    }
    vat_percent
    company_id
  }
}

query DirectHeroServices($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) {
  supply_services(first: $first, offset: $offset, orderBy: "id") {
    company_id
    created
    description
    ean
    id
    internal_identifier
    is_deleted
    is_fixed_net_price
    manufacturer
    modified
    name
    net_price_per_unit
    nr
    quantity
    time_minutes
    unit_type
    vat_percent
    file_upload {
      filename
      id
    }
    positions {
      __typename
      ... on Documents_SupplyProduct {
        id
        company_id
        ean
        matchcode
        internal_identifier
        name
        description
        manufacturer
        manufacturer_nr
        unit_type
        base_price
        net_price_per_unit
        vat_percent
        supply_service_id
        nr
        file_upload_id
        supply_operator_id
        supplier_id
        quantity_min
        quantity_interval
        price_quantity
        default_sales_price_id
        quantity
        time_minutes
        list_price
        modified
        created
        supply_product_sales_prices {
          id
          supply_sales_price_id
          net_price_per_unit
          label
          hasDifferentPrice
          modified
          created
        }
      }
      ... on WageGroup {
        id
        company_id
        name
        wage_cost_price
        wage_per_hour
        profit_markup
        created
        modified
        net_price_per_unit
        unit_type
        quantity
        time_minutes
        tracking_time_id
        activity
      }
    }
  }
}

types.description:
An RFC 3339 timestamp carrying a UTC offset, e.g. `2026-08-07T14:30:00+02:00`.

Input must include the offset (or `Z`) and whole seconds, and may carry at most three
fractional digits — so JavaScript's `new Date().toISOString()` is accepted as-is. A bare
day (`2026-08-07`), a space instead of `T`, a missing offset and Unix timestamps are all
rejected, and because that happens while coercing the input the whole operation fails.

Output always uses the offset form: never `Z`, never fractional seconds.

types.description:
A bucket of the receipts list — the tabs above the table — narrowing it by AND like any other
filter, so a bucket and a search term hold together.

Named on the server rather than assembled by each client, because the server has to know every
bucket anyway: the number beside a tab is the same query under a different one, and a rule stated
twice drifts until a tab says seven and lists five.

enumValues.description:
Every receipt the caller may see — no narrowing at all.

This is the domain's only spelling of "no bucket". A filter input may still arrive without
one, because an optional GraphQL argument can always be absent, but that is collapsed onto
this case the moment it is read, so nothing below the repository's entry points has to know
the two were ever different things.
enumValues.name: ALL

types.description:
The one status the receipts list shows per row. As a field it is a priority: the first state that
holds wins. As a filter value each case is a predicate over the stored data instead, so the sets
overlap: an overdue receipt whose wallet payment failed is listed under both OVERDUE and FAILED
while its field reads FAILED. Values of one group combine by OR, the groups by AND.
types.name: Receipt_ListStatus

types.description:
The channel a receipt was created through, fixed at creation. WEB and MOBILE are declared by the
caller (see DeclaredReceiptSource); COMMAND and API are set by the server. Receipts created before
this existed carry no source.
types.name: Receipt_ReceiptSource

types.description:
What kind of document a receipt is (its Belegart), as distinct from whether money comes in or
goes out. Capture suggests it from what it read; a reviewer may correct it, and an unclassified
receipt has none.

CANCELLATION (Stornorechnung) and CREDIT_NOTE (Gutschrift) reverse a charge. Booked as Einnahme,
they are stored with every amount positive and reduce project cost through the direction, and one
whose lines mix signs is refused. Booked as Ausgabe they keep the signs they were sent with, as
INVOICE and CASH_RECEIPT always do.

enumValues.description: Accepted as input only for companies with the extended Belegarten enabled.
enumValues.name: CREDIT_NOTE

enumValues.description: Accepted as input only for companies with the extended Belegarten enabled.
enumValues.name: CANCELLATION

The receipt comes back open, or already settled when it owes nothing, since a 0,00 payment cannot be recorded to close it later. An empty list ends the division and puts the whole line on projectMatchId, which is then required. Answers the receipt the position belongs to.

types.name: __Schema

types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name and description, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.
types.name: __Type

enumValues.name: OBJECT

enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields`, `interfaces`, and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.
enumValues.name: INTERFACE

enumValues.name: UNION

enumValues.name: ENUM

enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.
enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT

enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.
